value.title: Value
value.description: The corrected value: a number or a text

confirm_out_of_range.title: Confirm Out Of Range
confirm_out_of_range.description: Keep a number outside the field's usual range (the plan really says so)

AmendIn.title: AmendIn
AmendIn.description:
A correction, checked with the extraction contract's rules
(``core.extraction.corrections``): numbers in the document's conventions and the field's unit
(ha for an area is converted), impossible values refused, a value outside the field's usual
range only with ``confirm_out_of_range``, floors in the plan's notation, a land use the
document or the profile knows. 422 ``validation_error`` with the rule's ``type`` otherwise.

uncovered_hits.title: Uncovered Hits
uncovered_hits.description: Where searches outside coverage landed, most frequent first

AnalyticsEvent.title: AnalyticsEvent
AnalyticsEvent.description:
The 13 product events, the one list of them: BRD §6.2's eleven and the pilot scope's two
intent buttons (``market_data_interest``, ``ai_interest``). The API validates against it and
``ck_analytics_events_name`` is built from it (migration 0038).

differs.title: Differs
differs.description: True when the two areas differ by more than 0.5%

planned_area_stated_m2.title: Planned Area Stated M2
planned_area_stated_m2.description: The plan's own planned_parcel_area_m2 value when stated

stated_vs_geometry_delta_pct.title: Stated Vs Geometry Delta Pct
stated_vs_geometry_delta_pct.description: (stated − drawn parcel area) / drawn parcel area × 100

basis_area_m2.title: Basis Area M2
basis_area_m2.description: The area the calculations use: the planned parcel's area as its plan states it, else the drawn parcel's; the cadastral area without a planned parcel

editable.title: Editable
editable.description: The visitor may change it (the browser recalculates)

engine_edit_key.title: Engine Edit Key
engine_edit_key.description: Key of the engine's recalculate() edits for this item

effective_from.title: Effective From
effective_from.description: Applies to every set that states none: today (the default) or later

AssumptionsBatchIn.title: AssumptionsBatchIn
AssumptionsBatchIn.description:
Several zones' new sets saved together (the console's "Save changes"): one transaction,
all or nothing, one version and one audit row per set.

zone_id.title: Zone Id
zone_id.description: null = the municipality-wide row: its range factors widen single-figure market imports; it never supplies a zone's figures

land_rate.description: Land value per m² of parcel area

sale_rate.description: Selling price per m² saleable area

saleable_share.title: Saleable Share
saleable_share.description: The zone's default saleable share of GFA (0–1); null = the product's 0.70

effective_from.title: Effective From
effective_from.description: The municipality's local date the set applies from: today (the default) or later; a later date schedules it (the panel keeps the live set until then)

today.title: Today
today.description: The municipality's local date the statuses are computed for

zone_id.title: Zone Id
zone_id.description: null = the municipality-wide row (range factors only, never a zone's figures)

status.title: Status
status.description: live: what the panel and feasibility read today (the latest effective date on or before today, the newest version on a tie); scheduled: dated after today; superseded: replaced by a later date or a newer version; retired

is_current.title: Is Current
is_current.description: The newest version of the zone (the head of its history, what PUT builds on)

saleable_share.title: Saleable Share
saleable_share.description: The zone's default saleable share; null = the product's 0.70

effective_from.title: Effective From
effective_from.description: The date the set states it applies from

applies_from.title: Applies From
applies_from.description: Its place on the timeline: the effective date, never before the local day it was saved (a backdated market input applies from its approval)

effective_to.title: Effective To
effective_to.description: The local date it stops applying (exclusive): the next version's applies_from on the zone's timeline, or the day it was retired; null = open-ended

rate_sources.title: Rate Sources
rate_sources.description: Per rate, once reviewed market inputs set it: source, source_date, market_data_id, import_id, range_basis, effective_from (or set_by admin after a manual edit)

effective_from.title: Effective From
effective_from.description: Today (the default) or later; never carried over

AssumptionsUpdate.description: Fields of a new version based on the current row; omitted fields are carried over.
